skill.name: manim-animator
skill.description: Generate code-driven explanatory animation videos and precise vector graphics using the Manim engine. Use when the user requests mathematical visualizations, algorithm walkthroughs, scientific concept explanations, step-by-step derivations with LaTeX equations, or animations in the style of 3Blue1Brown — or explicitly mentions Manim, ManimCE, or ManimGL. Do not use for photorealistic AI video generation or standard timeline editing.
skill.userDescription: Create code-driven explanatory animation videos and precise vector graphics using the Manim engine. Ideal for mathematical visualizations, algorithm walkthroughs, scientific concept explanations, and 3Blue1Brown-style animations.
exampleQuestions: Create an animation explaining Pythagorean theorem with a step-by-step geometric proof and LaTeX equations.
Generate a 3Blue1Brown style visualization demonstrating how matrix multiplication works geometrically.
Animate the QuickSort algorithm partitioning an array with clear visual indicators.
